Occupancy layer (TILE_MAP_OFFSET) stores building_index + 0x8000; every `- 0x8000` in the gameplay fragments decodes an occupancy word read from TILE_INDEX/TILE_MAP_OFFSET to a building index, bounds-checked `<= 0x64` (=100 building-table count, e.g. 050_units.inc.c:1713, 090_special_sites_savegame.inc.c:1636) and/or scaled by BUILDING_RECORD_SIZE (050_units.inc.c:6006/6226, 060_buildings.inc.c:5844, 040_world_map.inc.c:4196). Token-identical (macro body 0x8000) so strict G1 proves value-identity; scope confined to the gameplay files where `- 0x8000` is uniformly this decode.

Encode side: a building index is written into the occupancy layer as buildingIndex + 0x8000 (e.g. 060_buildings.inc.c:216 *(_WORD*)(TILE_INDEX(row,column)) = buildingIndex + 0x8000; 050_units.inc.c:5307 written to TILE_MAP_OFFSET). All + 0x8000 sites in these files use a building-index variable. Token-identical.
